title: CAM walkthrough for the impatient
summary: Make a CAM job for a block with a pocket: one tool, a profile and a pocket operation, then G-code from a post processor.

credit.changes: Words in Simplified Technical English, FreeCAD 1.1 names. The page gives no sizes: the lesson makes a 60 mm x 40 mm x 20 mm Part block with a 30 mm x 20 mm x 8 mm pocket, not a Part Design body. The tool is a 5 mm end mill. The checks read the job, its tool and its operations.

hints: Find the workbench selector in the toolbar.

steps.say: Select **Block**. Push **{CAM_Job|Job}**. Push **OK**. Set the tool to number **4**, its feeds to 2 mm/s and its spindle to **2000 rpm**.
steps.why: The job holds the model, the stock, the tools and the operations.

picture.alt: The Job dialog: the base model and the template to start from.

hints: Find Job in the CAM toolbar.
Edit the default tool controller on the Tools tab of the job.
Tool number **4**, horizontal and vertical feed 2 mm/s, spindle **2000 rpm**, diameter 5 mm.

steps.say: Push **{CAM_Profile|Profile}**. Keep the default values. Push **OK**.
steps.why: The profile cuts round the outside of the block.

picture.alt: The tree with the job: its tool, its operations, the base model and the stock.

hints: Find Profile in the CAM toolbar.
The default side is the outside of the model.

steps.say: Select the floor of the pocket. Push **{CAM_Pocket_Shape|Pocket Shape}**. Set the step over to 50 % and the pattern to **Offset**. Push **OK**.
steps.why: The pocket operation clears the inside of the pocket down to its floor.
hints: Select the flat face at the bottom of the pocket first.
Find the step over and the pattern on the Operation tab.

steps.say: Select the job. Push **{CAM_Post|Post Process}**. Save the G-code as **walkthrough.nc**.
steps.why: The post processor writes G-code in the words of one machine.
hints: Find Post Process in the CAM toolbar.
The job's Output tab names the post processor and the file.

steps.say: Done: a CAM job with a profile and a pocket, written out as G-code.

picture.alt: The model of the walkthrough: a block with a square pocket.
